create_async_inference_client: create an AsyncInferenceClient instance to run async inference on Hugging Face models
run_chat_completion: run async chat completion with messages and optional streaming for language model responses
run_text_generation: run async text generation from a prompt with configurable parameters like max_new_tokens and temperature
run_text_to_image: run async text-to-image generation from a text prompt using diffusion models
run_audio_classification: run async audio classification on audio content to predict emotion or label categories
